detail.sDescription: This Firework Launcher provides long range support for organized squads. A shot from this weapon fired into the air will mark all targets within 60m of the shot.

eFnMod_0.sDescription:
Receiver Modification-
When the flare explodes, it will spot all enemies within line of sight of the flare, highlighting them on your Heads Up Display for you and your team. <Color:R=0.6 G=0.09 B=0.09>This mod is embedded and cannot be removed from the weapon.<Color:R=1 G=1 B=1>

aModifierEffects.sDescription: Spots hostile opponents within 60m of flare.
